basic_profile.bio: I'm a recent enthusiast diving into the world of billiards from my home in Austin, Texas. I work as a junior software developer, which keeps my weekdays busy, but I love unwinding with a game of pool during the weekends. I'm still learning the ropes, so I appreciate any advice from seasoned players. When I'm not working or practicing my billiards skills, I'm exploring my interest in fungi and mechanical watches. I'm single and enjoy my independence. My typical online hours are in the evenings, Pacific Time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of billiards, mostly gathered over the past few months from online tutorials and forums. My expertise in technology stems from my computer science degree and my current role in software development.
